purpose: a new independently held-out evaluation set for the epistemic semantics: premise handling and evidence-conflict surfacing, with positive controls and adversarial negative controls, frozen before any implementation is selected

freeze.scope: the UTF-8 bytes of the compact JSON document that is the 'cases' array of this dataset, followed by a single line feed
freeze.frozenBefore: the measurement of any candidate implementation of the premise semantics, and before any algorithm was selected for the repair

manifest.method: the corpus documents are imported through the production acquisition path; every gold claim is the production claim whose proposition equals a sentence of a corpus document, and the builder proves the sentence is verbatim in that document before the case is written out
verifications: the gold proposition occurs verbatim in its corpus document
the gold claim exists in the production workspace and was introduced by that document's source
the gold proposition of this set is not a gold proposition of the 29-case development set nor of the C2A 38-case held-out set
a question of this set shares no normalised token sequence of length >= 4 with any development question, any development assertion or any C2A held-out question
an UNSUPPORTED case names content terms that occur in no corpus document
the nine classes are present, and every corpus document carries a case
no case repeats a question or an id

classes.SUPPORTED_PREMISE: the corpus supports the presupposition; the expected disposition is ANSWERED and a refusal is a false refusal
classes.REFUTED_PREMISE: the corpus contradicts the presupposition; the expected disposition is REFUTED and the contradicting claim and source must be cited
classes.UNSUPPORTED_PREMISE: no evidence either way; the expected disposition is UNSUPPORTED and calling the premise false is a false contradiction
classes.IRRELEVANT_REFUTATION: the corpus holds a claim that looks like a refutation but is about another subject; the expected disposition is NOT_REFUTED and the look-alike claim must not be used as the contradiction
classes.CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE: two corpus claims that cannot both hold; the expected disposition is CONFLICT_SURFACED and both sides are cited with their provenance
classes.AMBIGUOUS_READINGS: several defensible readings; the expected disposition is AMBIGUITY_SURFACED and no reading may be silently chosen
classes.LEXICAL_NEGATION: the surface wording negates or inverts the relation; the expected disposition follows the evidence, not the wording
classes.PARAPHRASE: the same presupposition phrased differently; the expected disposition is the one of the presupposition, and string matching cannot find it
classes.NO_PREMISE: a plain factual question; the expected disposition is ANSWERED and an abstention is an over-refusal
